scope: one shared station-group SystemRepair default for two explicitly named bases
source_rule: The installed dictionary permits Station.GSTID in SystemRepair.STID. A shared GSTID on two Station rows can give a single SystemRepair default to both; StockAllocation.STID, StationStructure.STID and ItemStationStructure.STID are individual station references in the installed dictionary and stay explicit.
delta: Set Station.GSTID=BASE-GRP on BASE-01 and BASE-02. Replace their two identical SystemRepair rows with one BASE-GRP row. Change description only otherwise; keep their distinct stock, support, unit, deployment and operations rows, mission schedule, seed and horizon fixed.
pre_run_hypotheses: The frozen group-default input imports, exports 22 authored populated tables exactly, converts with zero errors, calculates and produces a valid report.
The single BASE-GRP SystemRepair row is applied to both individual bases without merging their units, aircraft or physical stock ledgers.
The fixed-seed first failure at BASE-01 uses the same half-hour system replacement task, local spare and depot replenishment as the accepted explicit parent.
The group-default run has the same six mission outcomes and aggregate ResultSummary plus all 72 System and 72 Stock half-hour rows as its accepted parent, with only description changed.
Per-station identity and terminal physical stock remain distinguishable in the native event log despite the group input reference.
decision_rule: If group expansion, import/export, conversion, physical ledgers or report parity fail, retain a sealed diagnostic and repair in a new version; do not infer generic group precedence from this one run.
limits: One SystemRepair group default, one seed and 36-hour horizon; no individual station override yet.
StockAllocation and support links remain individual-station rows; group acceptance in those tables is not claimed.
No GUI plot/visual or cross-engine parity conclusion.
